name: Shomra - AI agent security
description: Installs the Shomra CLI and wires the runtime firewall into the coding agents in this container, so the guard exists before the first keystroke rather than after the first incident.

version.description: Version of @shomra/agent to install (npm dist-tag or exact version).

protect.description: Run `shomra protect` on create, wiring the tool-call / tool-result / prompt guards into every coding agent detected in the container.

rules.description: Run `shomra rules --write` on create. Off by default: it writes into the workspace, and a feature that edits a developer's committed files without being asked is a surprise, not a convenience.
